subject: Compliance onboarding trajectory: SOC 2 / SIG scope, DPA language, and retention checkpoints

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Compliance onboarding trajectory: SOC 2 / SIG scope, DPA language, and retention checkpoints

Hi Lena,

Thanks for the time earlier — attaching a first-pass mutual action plan that isolates the security/compliance gates we discussed. Key items in the MAP:
- SOC 2 readiness checklist and expected evidence deliverables (see SOC2-evidence-index.pdf)
- SIG/CAIQ responses we can share during the eval window
- DPA baseline language and a short options matrix for retention periods (30/90/365 days)

Proposed timeline:
1) Week 0 (this week): align on scope and final MAP sign-off
2) Week 1–2: SIG packet & SOC 2 evidence collection (we provide an index + shared folder)
3) Week 3: security deep-dive call if any open items remain
4) Week 4: legal DPA redlines and procurement kickoff

Can you confirm that the 90-day retention bucket is acceptable for test data during the POC, or do you require a stricter default? Also confirm whether we should include an on-prem option in the MAP (your team signaled interest).

Attachments: Fincore_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-index.pdf

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fincore.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@fincore.com
Date: 2027-06-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance onboarding trajectory: SOC 2 / SIG scope, DPA language, and retention checkpoints

Rachel — thanks for the doc. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) SIG/CAIQ: We need to understand whether Redwood will provide a completed CAIQ, or if you expect us to run through it during the POC and validate answers. If you can pre-populate common answers (networking, encryption at rest/in transit, key management) that would save a lot of time.

2) DPA: Our legal has two non-negotiables: breach notification within 48 hours and ability to request export of customer data in a machine-readable form. Can you confirm Redwood's standard positions on those points?

3) Retention: For POC telemetry we prefer 30 days, but production data should be adjustable to 90 or 365 based on business needs. Will that be configurable per environment?

Also, can we schedule the security deep-dive for next Tuesday (6/29) morning PST?

-Lena
Head of Risk & Compliance, Fincore
security@fincore.com

Subject: Re: Compliance onboarding trajectory: SOC 2 / SIG scope, DPA language, and retention checkpoints

Hi Lena — jumping in on the SIG and DPA points.

SIG/CAIQ: We will provide a pre-populated CAIQ packet (draft) that covers the standard controls we operate under. That packet will include references to our SOC 2 report where applicable, and a mapping table (CAIQ question -> SOC control/evidence). For any customer-specific variance we can flag items as "under review" and commit to a follow-up answer during the security deep-dive.

DPA: Redwood's baseline DPA includes: 48-hour breach notification, customer-export capability in JSON/CSV for standard resources, and options for contractual retention limits. For Fincore's procurement team, we'll highlight the two clauses Lena mentioned in the DPA redline package. If legal requests stricter language, we can surface that to our legal ops and propose a narrow concession for the enterprise agreement.

Retention/Config: Retention buckets are configurable per deployment. For hosted evals we default telemetry to 30 days and kept logs to 90 days; for production you can select a 90 or 365-day profile. If you need an air-gapped on-prem option, data residency and retention are controlled by your deployment team and we document the recommended retention profiles in the MAP.

I'll attach the draft CAIQ and a short mapping table to the shared drive this afternoon. Proposed security deep-dive: 2027-06-29 at 10:00 AM PST — does that work for your team?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
